explanation: The Conquest of Paraíba article, § Details, opens the account of the expedition with the conquest that preceded it: "After conquering Recife, Lichthart decided to set sail for Paraíba. In December, Lichthart led an expedition towards Paraíba with a fleet comprising 21 ships and 11 yachts". The Dutch hold on Recife is what this atlas carries as `dutch-brazil-1630-1654`, whose own summary dates it from 1630 with "the West India Company’s headquarters and the capital Mauritsstad at Recife"; the fleet that took Paraíba sailed from there and was the colony’s. `precondition-of` and not `caused`: the article states what the expedition set out from and not that holding Recife made the conquest follow. Probable: Wikipedia alone, at two revisions.
